description: This PHP script generates and manages the list view for the Documents module in a CRM system, including sorting, filtering, folder management, permissions, and rendering the list view template.

classes.name: ListViewController
classes.description: Controller class for managing list view operations such as header info and entries retrieval.

classes.name: Documents
classes.description: Model class representing document records, handling sorting and folder management.

classes.name: CustomView
classes.description: Class for managing custom view configurations and permissions.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine wrapper for rendering views.

methods.name: getViewId
methods.description: Retrieves the view ID for the current module.

methods.name: getCustomViewCombo
methods.description: Generates HTML for custom view selection dropdown.

methods.name: getCustomViewByCvid
methods.description: Gets details of a custom view by its ID.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the current sort order for list view.

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Returns the current order by field for list view.

methods.name: initSortbyField
methods.description: Initializes sorting fields for the Documents module.
